admission.justification: Task and lifecycle projection refreshes with complete accepted wake paths. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Task and lifecycle projection refreshes with complete accepted wake paths.
conditions: Dependency consumers are closed transitively over retained payloads.
Incomplete or uncertain paths fall back to full reconciliation.
exclusions: Full reconciliation still checks all domains; quiet workspace-only wakes do not imply a full closeout census.
statement: A path-directed refresh reads the changed document and its actual dependency consumers, while explicit full reconciliation preserves complete projection semantics.
